text: {"summary":"The merged proposal consolidates the cluster's REST API recommendations into a single canonical design that preserves the per-source trade-offs while enforcing the hard single-binary constraint.","approach":"## Approach\n\nAdopt the most general invariant that all source proposals agree on: expose the REST API as a stateless HTTP service that performs CRUD over a normalized library/books resource, validates inputs at the edge, and persists via SQLite with prepared statements. Keep the per-source differences (logging middleware, error taxonomy, pagination strategy) as plug-in modules rather than baked into the core handler. This satisfies the `single_binary` hard constraint because every module compiles into the same binary and the route handlers are the only public surface.","tradeoffs":["Loses the per-source colour-theory nuance (here: per-resource middleware nuances)","Trade-offs from intermediate sketches (pagination vs. cursor, file-backed DB vs. SQLite) are abstracted away behind modules"],"evidence":["sk_000","sk_002","sk_004","sk_006"],"sources":["p_000","p_001","p_002","p_003","p_004","p_005","p_006"],"hard_constraint_check":{"single_binary":true},"expected_validation":"The merged proposal survives the gate, is included as one row in `proposals/`, the cluster has all 7 members, and the synthesized sidecar `synthesized/s_00.json` carries `source_proposals | length == 7`.","schema_version":"v1"}
